commands.quality_gate: go vet ./... && go test ./... && go build ./...
commands.quality_gate_strict: go vet ./... && go test -race ./... && golangci-lint run && go build ./...

test.heading: ### Go Testing
test.content:
Run all tests:
```bash
go test ./... -v
```

Run with coverage:
```bash
go test -coverprofile=/tmp/coverage.out ./...
go tool cover -html=/tmp/coverage.out -o /tmp/coverage.html
```

Run specific package:
```bash
go test ./pkg/mypackage -v
```

Run with race detection:
```bash
go test -race ./...
```

Skip integration tests:
```bash
go test -short ./...
```

build.heading: ### Go Building
build.content:
Build all packages:
```bash
go build ./...
```

Build specific binary:
```bash
go build -o bin/myapp ./cmd/myapp
```

Build with optimizations:
```bash
go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/myapp ./cmd/myapp
```

Install to GOPATH/bin:
```bash
go install ./cmd/myapp
```

quality-gate.heading: ### Go Quality Gates
quality-gate.content:
Run all quality checks:
```bash
go vet ./... && go test ./... && go build ./...
```

Format check:
```bash
gofmt -l . && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"
```

Run with race and coverage:
```bash
go test -race -coverprofile=/tmp/coverage.out ./...
```

Static analysis:
```bash
staticcheck ./...
```
